name: Bazil Thredd
summary: In the Stormwind Stockade, Bazil Thredd leads the Defias inmates in revolt from the eastern cell block. Edwin VanCleef's lieutenant has been imprisoned there since the Stonemasons' riots.

sections.title: VanCleef's Lieutenant
sections.body: Bazil Thredd stood beside Edwin VanCleef when the Stonemasons Guild rose against Stormwind's nobility. The guild had been refused payment for rebuilding the city, and VanCleef rejected the government's appeasements and sparked open revolt. Thredd served as his chief lieutenant and most trusted assistant. The city guard captured Thredd during the violent clashes that followed. VanCleef and the surviving masons fled into Westfall and formed the Defias Brotherhood, while Thredd was sent into the Stormwind Stockade.

sections.title: The Stockade Uprising
sections.body: A prison riot has overrun the guards, opened the cells, and turned the Stockade into an armed fortress beneath the Mage Quarter. Thredd commands the imprisoned Defias bandits, insurgents, and allied cutthroats from a post in the eastern wing, guarded by an ogre named Hamhock. For years, he had stayed silent behind bars, seemingly forsaken. Now Warden Thelwater wants Thredd's head, hoping to break the rebellion's leadership before the chaos reaches the city streets.

sections.title: The Curious Visitor
sections.body: A man using the name Maelik began visiting Bazil Thredd once or twice a week a few months before the uprising. Warden Thelwater had long thought the Brotherhood abandoned Thredd to rot, and the visits raised his suspicions. Yet Maelik's papers proved entirely legitimate. Thelwater doubts the visitor will return now that Thredd is dead. Anyone carrying papers that good is well connected, and the visits suggest outside hands in the city had reached the Defias lieutenant.

faq.answer: Bazil Thredd was Edwin VanCleef's right hand during the Stonemasons' rebellion in Stormwind. Captured in the riots and imprisoned in the Stockade, he now leads the mutinous inmates.

faq.q: Where can Bazil Thredd be found?
faq.answer: Bazil Thredd is deep inside the Stormwind Stockade, beneath the Canal District near the Mage Quarter. From the main hallway intersection, take the eastern cell block and pass the ogre Hamhock; Thredd commands from the center cell in the far chamber.

The inmates have overpowered the guards, opened the cells, and taken the Stockade's halls. Bazil Thredd, the prison's most important Defias prisoner, commands the rioting bandits and convicts while Warden Thelwater tries to keep the revolt from reaching Stormwind's streets.

faq.q: Why does Warden Thelwater want Thredd dead?
faq.answer: Warden Thelwater believes the uprising cannot be quelled while Thredd directs it. With the guards overwhelmed and inmates holding the complex, he orders Thredd executed to break the rebellion's command.

faq.q: Who was visiting Thredd before the riot?
faq.answer: A quiet man using the name Maelik visited Thredd once or twice a week in the months before the uprising. Thelwater distrusted him, but his papers were legitimate, suggesting well connected hands in the city had reached the Defias lieutenant.

faq.q: What was Thredd's role in the Stonemasons Guild?
faq.answer: Thredd was Edwin VanCleef's principal lieutenant during Stormwind's rebuilding and the labor disputes that followed. He helped lead the guild's resistance after the House of Nobles refused to pay for their work.

angles.text: A Defias revolt beneath Stormwind's streets threatens the capital, and Warden Thelwater wants its leader dealt with before it spreads.
As a human, you face a living reminder of the Stonemasons' riots that set the Defias Brotherhood against the kingdom.
